# Green Card Agency

> Green Card Agency is the multilingual website of SINEDIS Sp. z o.o., a Polish insurance agent registered in the KNF insurance intermediaries register under number 11257162/A. The site explains and accepts applications for OC graniczne (border motor third-party liability insurance) for eligible foreign-registered vehicles.

SINEDIS Sp. z o.o. is an insurance agent, not the insurer. Availability, price, territorial scope, start date, and issuance depend on the vehicle registration, route, submitted documents, insurer requirements, and the final policy. OC graniczne covers third-party motor liability within the territory stated in the policy; it is not comprehensive motor insurance and does not cover damage to the insured vehicle. Do not assume that one policy covers every transit country.

## Main pages

- [English home](https://greencard.agency/en): Product overview, price calculator, and insurance application form.
- [Route directory](https://greencard.agency/en/routes): Index of supported origin-to-destination insurance guides.
- [Europolis border insurance](https://greencard.agency/en/europolis): Information about OC graniczne for eligible foreign-registered vehicles travelling in the covered territory.
- [About SINEDIS](https://greencard.agency/en/about): Company role, registration details, and operating information.
- [Contacts](https://greencard.agency/en/contacts): Contact details and registered office address.
